o.text:
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طوپراق (ṭopraq), from Proto-Turkic *toprak (“earth, soil”). Developed through metathesis, compare Turkish toprak. Cognate with Azerbaijani toz.
Cognates
Cognate with Crimean Tatar topraq, Bashkir тупраҡ (topraq), Kazakh топырақ (topıraq), Kyrgyz топурак (topurak), Kyrgyz тобрак (tobrak), Tatar туфрак (tufraq), Turkmen toprak, Tuvan довурак (dovurak), Uzbek tuproq, Uyghur تۇپراق (tupraq), dialectal Yakut тобурах (toburaq, “dust”), Chuvash тӑпра (tăpra).
